title: Ordinary module restriction along an open immersion preserves limits
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. The restriction functor on sheaves of modules [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits] preserves all small limits of diagrams with object and morphism universes $u$, where $X,Y:\mathrm{Scheme}_u$; in particular it preserves kernels. Modules are those of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

source.place: Lemma 01AH (lemma-limits-colimits), sectionwise limits; restriction to an open is sectionwise by Sheaves Lemma 00A0. Existing Lean proof: WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/QuasicoherentKernel.lean:95-106.

proof.text: The underlying presheaf of abelian groups of a restricted module is obtained by precomposition with the open-image functor. Right whiskering by the forgetful functor and precomposition preserve limits pointwise. The forgetful functor from scheme modules to presheaves of abelian groups preserves and reflects limits. Apply preservesLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves. This is the existing proof at WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/QuasicoherentKernel.lean:95-106, with no sorry.
